author: Codex AI
scope: Document-based work triage of the 151 genuinely unfinished image acceptance items. No mass approval, no new visual review and no legacy manifest/status mutation.
historicalMethod: 현재 사건 본문과 실제 연결 PNG 원본·360x800 중앙 크롭 접촉시트 24장을 직접 시각 대조. 크롭 판정은 계산 재현이며 에뮬레이터 실행 증명과 구분한다.
limitations: Historical defects were recorded from original artwork and simulated centre crops, not a fresh per-item review in this triage.
Crop-only candidates may need portrait recomposition; moving the focal point cannot retain widely separated subjects automatically.
Production/file-existence fields in old CSV are snapshots. Use originalExistsNow and current runtime routing rather than treating old NO/MISSING labels as 151 missing PNGs.
Current acceptance validator does not directly represent presentation-variant/focal metadata; approvals must truthfully cover the actual delivered display and preserve original approval scope.
